vuln.name: CSP Contains Wildcard Source
vuln.description: The Content-Security-Policy uses a wildcard source (e.g. script-src * or *.com), allowing scripts or styles from any origin or any subdomain of a public suffix.
vuln.impact: An attacker who controls any matching origin (or any subdomain of the wildcarded domain) can inject executable content, defeating CSP.
vuln.recommendation: Replace wildcards with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins. Avoid * and broad *.com patterns.
